# TYZ τ arithmetic source and dependency record

This new arithmetic file ports only the actual pure-quaternion lift and integral-coordinate proof from:

- `Deicyde/diophantine-z-q@c1e4ed1b8765f016c8fd5808e79bb0124b364952`, `ZInQKernel/Contrib/OneProof/TYZLemma29Mod2.lean`, lines 617–780; the Hurwitz coordinate definition is at 256–257.
- Original complete source SHA-256: `9dede3a4b33925b153877cf9d49932e7d88b511dbc2d7f3f35f0ca24e3d1fbf8`.
- Source link: https://github.com/Deicyde/diophantine-z-q/blob/c1e4ed1b8765f016c8fd5808e79bb0124b364952/ZInQKernel/Contrib/OneProof/TYZLemma29Mod2.lean

The original file has no standalone copyright/license header. This record preserves its source attribution and does not purport to grant a new license. Existing source and third-party license/notice texts are not altered.

Changes in the new `ZInQKernel/Contrib/TYZTauArithmetic.lean`:

1. Use namespace `ZInQ.Contrib.TYZTauArithmetic` and the original upstream `QNeg` carrier/instances from `RouteK/Rank5b/Sec3/RedeiStatement.lean`, rather than importing the missing H29 world.
2. Write the mathematical representation, ring-of-integers coordinate condition, and final τ statement literally; no missing H29 Prop alias or number-field model is introduced.
3. Rename `pq`/denominator and admissibility helpers locally and specialize the integral-coordinate conclusion directly.
4. Refer directly to the actual generator `QuadraticAlgebra.omega`, rather than copying `sqrtNeg` as a new shadow constant.
5. For the class-three representation, consume the canonical shared Atlas natural-witness theorem and cast its equation to ℤ; for class one, consume the exact canonical Jones–Pall supplier. No second supplier implementation is created.

The proof of all integral elements uses genuine integral trace/norm, rational denominator coprimality and squarefreeness, and parity, not a claim that the ring of integers is generated by a chosen symbol. In particular n=1, half-integer coordinates in class three, and 4-divisibility in class one remain in the literal target.
